description: The 100 most common Japanese Kanji characters

cards.question: 日
cards.explanation: Readings: にち (nichi), ひ (hi). Like a window with sunlight. Example: 日本 (nihon) = Japan.

cards.question: 一
cards.explanation: Readings: いち (ichi), ひと (hito). One horizontal stroke = one. Example: 一人 (hitori) = one person.

cards.question: 国
cards.explanation: Readings: こく (koku), くに (kuni). Treasure (玉) inside borders. Example: 外国 (gaikoku) = foreign country.

cards.question: 人
cards.explanation: Readings: じん (jin), ひと (hito). A person walking. Example: 日本人 (nihonjin) = Japanese person.

cards.question: 年
cards.explanation: Readings: ねん (nen), とし (toshi). Grain harvest cycle. Example: 今年 (kotoshi) = this year.

cards.question: 大
cards.explanation: Readings: だい (dai), おお (oo). Person with arms stretched wide. Example: 大学 (daigaku) = university.

cards.question: 十
cards.explanation: Readings: じゅう (juu), とお (too). Cross representing 10. Example: 十分 (juubun) = enough/10 minutes.

cards.question: 二
cards.explanation: Readings: に (ni), ふた (futa). Two horizontal lines. Example: 二人 (futari) = two people.

cards.question: 本
cards.explanation: Readings: ほん (hon), もと (moto). Tree with root marked. Example: 日本 (nihon) = Japan, 本 (hon) = book.

cards.question: 中
cards.explanation: Readings: ちゅう (chuu), なか (naka). Box with line through center. Example: 中国 (chuugoku) = China.

cards.question: 長
cards.explanation: Readings: ちょう (chou), なが (naga). Long flowing hair. Example: 社長 (shachou) = company president.

cards.question: 出
cards.explanation: Readings: しゅつ (shutsu), で (de). Mountain peaks emerging. Example: 出口 (deguchi) = exit.

cards.question: 三
cards.explanation: Readings: さん (san), み (mi). Three horizontal lines. Example: 三人 (sannin) = three people.

cards.question: 時
cards.explanation: Readings: じ (ji), とき (toki). Sun + temple = time told by temples. Example: 時間 (jikan) = time.

cards.question: 行
cards.explanation: Readings: こう (kou), い (i), ゆ (yu). Crossroads. Example: 行く (iku) = to go, 銀行 (ginkou) = bank.

cards.question: 見
cards.explanation: Readings: けん (ken), み (mi). Eye on legs. Example: 見る (miru) = to see, 意見 (iken) = opinion.

cards.question: 月
cards.explanation: Readings: げつ (getsu), つき (tsuki). Crescent moon shape. Example: 今月 (kongetsu) = this month.

cards.question: 分
cards.explanation: Readings: ぶん (bun), わ (wa), ふん (fun). Cutting with a knife. Example: 五分 (gofun) = 5 minutes.

cards.question: 後
cards.explanation: Readings: ご (go), あと (ato), のち (nochi). Walking behind. Example: 午後 (gogo) = afternoon.

cards.question: 前
cards.explanation: Readings: ぜん (zen), まえ (mae). Walking in front. Example: 午前 (gozen) = morning, 名前 (namae) = name.

cards.question: 生
cards.explanation: Readings: せい (sei), い (i), う (u), は (ha). Plant sprouting from earth. Example: 学生 (gakusei) = student.

cards.question: 五
cards.explanation: Readings: ご (go), いつ (itsu). Cross with top and bottom. Example: 五人 (gonin) = five people.

cards.question: 間
cards.explanation: Readings: かん (kan), あいだ (aida), ま (ma). Sun peeking through gate. Example: 時間 (jikan) = time.

cards.question: 上
cards.explanation: Readings: じょう (jou), うえ (ue), あ (a), のぼ (nobo). Line above base. Example: 上手 (jouzu) = skillful.

cards.question: 東
cards.explanation: Readings: とう (tou), ひがし (higashi). Sun rising behind tree. Example: 東京 (toukyou) = Tokyo.

cards.question: 四
cards.explanation: Readings: し (shi), よん (yon), よ (yo). Mouth breathing four times. Example: 四人 (yonin) = four people.

cards.question: 今
cards.explanation: Readings: こん (kon), いま (ima). Roof over something. Example: 今日 (kyou) = today.

cards.question: 金
cards.explanation: Readings: きん (kin), かね (kane). Golden nuggets underground. Example: お金 (okane) = money.

cards.question: 九
cards.explanation: Readings: きゅう (kyuu), く (ku), ここの (kokono). Almost complete circle. Example: 九月 (kugatsu) = September.

cards.question: 入
cards.explanation: Readings: にゅう (nyuu), はい (hai), い (i). Arrow entering. Example: 入口 (iriguchi) = entrance.

cards.question: 学
cards.explanation: Readings: がく (gaku), まな (mana). Child under a roof learning. Example: 大学 (daigaku) = university.

cards.question: 高
cards.explanation: Readings: こう (kou), たか (taka). Tall building with roof. Example: 高校 (koukou) = high school.

cards.question: 円
cards.explanation: Readings: えん (en), まる (maru). Round coin. Example: 百円 (hyakuen) = 100 yen.

cards.question: 子
cards.explanation: Readings: し (shi), こ (ko). Baby with arms. Example: 子供 (kodomo) = child.

cards.question: 外
cards.explanation: Readings: がい (gai), そと (soto), ほか (hoka). Evening moon = outside at night. Example: 外国 (gaikoku) = foreign country.

cards.question: 八
cards.explanation: Readings: はち (hachi), や (ya), よう (you). Two lines spreading apart. Example: 八月 (hachigatsu) = August.

cards.question: 六
cards.explanation: Readings: ろく (roku), む (mu), むっ (mu). Roof with legs. Example: 六月 (rokugatsu) = June.

cards.question: 下
cards.explanation: Readings: か (ka), した (shita), さ (sa), お (o), くだ (kuda). Line below base. Example: 下手 (heta) = unskillful.

cards.question: 来
cards.explanation: Readings: らい (rai), く (ku), き (ki). Rice plants coming in harvest. Example: 来年 (rainen) = next year.

cards.question: 気
cards.explanation: Readings: き (ki), け (ke). Steam rising. Example: 元気 (genki) = energetic, 天気 (tenki) = weather.

cards.question: 小
cards.explanation: Readings: しょう (shou), ちい (chii), こ (ko), お (o). Small dividing strokes. Example: 小学校 (shougakkou) = elementary school.

cards.question: 七
cards.explanation: Readings: しち (shichi), なな (nana). Bent line crossing. Example: 七月 (shichigatsu) = July.

cards.question: 山
cards.explanation: Readings: さん (san), やま (yama). Mountain peaks! Example: 富士山 (fujisan) = Mt. Fuji.

cards.question: 話
cards.explanation: Readings: わ (wa), はな (hana), はなし (hanashi). Words (言) from tongue. Example: 電話 (denwa) = telephone.

cards.question: 女
cards.explanation: Readings: じょ (jo), おんな (onna), め (me). Woman kneeling elegantly. Example: 女性 (josei) = woman/female.

cards.question: 北
cards.explanation: Readings: ほく (hoku), きた (kita). Two people back-to-back, fleeing cold. Example: 北海道 (hokkaidou) = Hokkaido.

cards.question: 午
cards.explanation: Readings: ご (go). Sundial at noon. Example: 午前 (gozen) = morning, 午後 (gogo) = afternoon.

cards.question: 百
cards.explanation: Readings: ひゃく (hyaku). One + white = shining 100. Example: 百円 (hyakuen) = 100 yen.

cards.question: 書
cards.explanation: Readings: しょ (sho), か (ka). Hand holding brush. Example: 辞書 (jisho) = dictionary.

cards.question: 先
cards.explanation: Readings: せん (sen), さき (saki). Legs walking ahead. Example: 先生 (sensei) = teacher.

cards.question: 名
cards.explanation: Readings: めい (mei), な (na). Mouth under evening = calling name. Example: 名前 (namae) = name.

cards.question: 川
cards.explanation: Readings: せん (sen), かわ (kawa). Three flowing streams. Example: 川 (kawa) = river.

cards.question: 千
cards.explanation: Readings: せん (sen), ち (chi). Cross with extra stroke. Example: 千円 (senen) = 1000 yen.

cards.question: 水
cards.explanation: Readings: すい (sui), みず (mizu). Water drops splashing. Example: 水曜日 (suiyoubi) = Wednesday.

cards.question: 半
cards.explanation: Readings: はん (han), なか (naka). Dividing line through middle. Example: 半分 (hanbun) = half.

cards.question: 男
cards.explanation: Readings: だん (dan), おとこ (otoko). Rice field + power = man working. Example: 男性 (dansei) = man/male.

cards.question: 西
cards.explanation: Readings: せい (sei), にし (nishi). Bird in nest at sunset. Example: 関西 (kansai) = Kansai region.

cards.question: 電
cards.explanation: Readings: でん (den). Rain + lightning field. Example: 電話 (denwa) = phone, 電車 (densha) = train.

cards.question: 校
cards.explanation: Readings: こう (kou). Tree + crossed sticks = learning place. Example: 学校 (gakkou) = school.

cards.question: 語
cards.explanation: Readings: ご (go), かた (kata). Words (言) + self (吾). Example: 日本語 (nihongo) = Japanese language.

cards.question: 土
cards.explanation: Readings: ど (do), つち (tsuchi). Mound of earth. Example: 土曜日 (doyoubi) = Saturday.

cards.question: 木
cards.explanation: Readings: もく (moku), き (ki), こ (ko). Tree with branches and roots. Example: 木曜日 (mokuyoubi) = Thursday.

cards.question: 聞
cards.explanation: Readings: ぶん (bun), き (ki), もん (mon). Ear at gate = listening. Example: 新聞 (shinbun) = newspaper.

cards.question: 食
cards.explanation: Readings: しょく (shoku), た (ta), く (ku). Roof + good = eating well. Example: 食べる (taberu) = to eat.

cards.question: 車
cards.explanation: Readings: しゃ (sha), くるま (kuruma). Wheels on an axle. Example: 電車 (densha) = train, 自動車 (jidousha) = car.

cards.question: 何
cards.explanation: Readings: か (ka), なに (nani), なん (nan). Person + can = what can they do? Example: 何 (nani) = what.

cards.question: 南
cards.explanation: Readings: なん (nan), みなみ (minami). Plants growing in warm south. Example: 南 (minami) = south.

cards.question: 万
cards.explanation: Readings: まん (man), ばん (ban). Grass spreading = many. Example: 一万円 (ichimanen) = 10,000 yen.

cards.question: 毎
cards.explanation: Readings: まい (mai). Mother doing something daily. Example: 毎日 (mainichi) = every day.

cards.question: 白
cards.explanation: Readings: はく (haku), しろ (shiro). Sun ray creating white light. Example: 白い (shiroi) = white.

cards.question: 天
cards.explanation: Readings: てん (ten), あま (ama), あめ (ame). Above a person's head. Example: 天気 (tenki) = weather.

cards.question: 母
cards.explanation: Readings: ぼ (bo), はは (haha). Woman with two dots = nurturing breasts. Example: お母さん (okaasan) = mother.

cards.question: 火
cards.explanation: Readings: か (ka), ひ (hi), ほ (ho). Flames rising. Example: 火曜日 (kayoubi) = Tuesday.

cards.question: 右
cards.explanation: Readings: う (u), みぎ (migi). Hand + mouth = right hand feeds mouth. Example: 右 (migi) = right.

cards.question: 読
cards.explanation: Readings: どく (doku), よ (yo). Words (言) + sell = reading words. Example: 読む (yomu) = to read.

cards.question: 友
cards.explanation: Readings: ゆう (yuu), とも (tomo). Two hands helping each other. Example: 友達 (tomodachi) = friend.

cards.question: 左
cards.explanation: Readings: さ (sa), ひだり (hidari). Hand + work = left hand works. Example: 左 (hidari) = left.

cards.question: 休
cards.explanation: Readings: きゅう (kyuu), やす (yasu). Person against tree = resting. Example: 休む (yasumu) = to rest.

cards.question: 父
cards.explanation: Readings: ふ (fu), ちち (chichi). Person with authority. Example: お父さん (otousan) = father.

cards.question: 雨
cards.explanation: Readings: う (u), あめ (ame), あま (ama). Clouds with raindrops. Example: 雨 (ame) = rain.

cards.question: 道
cards.explanation: Readings: どう (dou), みち (michi). Walking + head = knowing the way. Example: 道 (michi) = road, 柔道 (juudou) = judo.

cards.question: 駅
cards.explanation: Readings: えき (eki). Horse + stacked = horses at rest stop. Example: 駅 (eki) = train station.

cards.question: 会
cards.explanation: Readings: かい (kai), あ (a). Roof + speak = meeting together. Example: 会う (au) = to meet, 会社 (kaisha) = company.

cards.question: 同
cards.explanation: Readings: どう (dou), おな (ona). Same container for all. Example: 同じ (onaji) = same.

cards.question: 事
cards.explanation: Readings: じ (ji), ず (zu), こと (koto). Hand doing something. Example: 仕事 (shigoto) = work.

cards.question: 自
cards.explanation: Readings: じ (ji), し (shi), みずか (mizuka). Point at nose = self. Example: 自分 (jibun) = oneself.

cards.question: 社
cards.explanation: Readings: しゃ (sha), やしろ (yashiro). Altar + earth = shrine, company. Example: 会社 (kaisha) = company.

cards.question: 発
cards.explanation: Readings: はつ (hatsu), ほつ (hotsu). Feet starting to leave. Example: 出発 (shuppatsu) = departure.

cards.question: 者
cards.explanation: Readings: しゃ (sha), もの (mono). Old man = wise person. Example: 記者 (kisha) = journalist.

cards.question: 地
cards.explanation: Readings: ち (chi), じ (ji). Earth + foundation. Example: 地下 (chika) = underground.

cards.question: 業
cards.explanation: Readings: ぎょう (gyou), ごう (gou), わざ (waza). Complex work activities. Example: 授業 (jugyou) = class.

cards.question: 方
cards.explanation: Readings: ほう (hou), かた (kata). Forked path direction. Example: 方向 (houkou) = direction.

cards.question: 新
cards.explanation: Readings: しん (shin), あたら (atara), あら (ara), にい (nii). Tree cut for new wood. Example: 新聞 (shinbun) = newspaper.

cards.question: 場
cards.explanation: Readings: じょう (jou), ば (ba). Earth + ease = comfortable place. Example: 場所 (basho) = place.

cards.question: 員
cards.explanation: Readings: いん (in). Mouth + cowrie shell = counted member. Example: 会員 (kaiin) = member.

cards.question: 立
cards.explanation: Readings: りつ (ritsu), た (ta). Person standing on ground. Example: 立つ (tatsu) = to stand.

cards.question: 開
cards.explanation: Readings: かい (kai), ひら (hira), あ (a). Door with hands opening both sides. Example: 開く (hiraku) = to open.

cards.question: 手
cards.explanation: Readings: しゅ (shu), て (te), た (ta). Fingers and palm. Example: 上手 (jouzu) = skillful, 手紙 (tegami) = letter.

cards.question: 力
cards.explanation: Readings: りょく (ryoku), りき (riki), ちから (chikara). Flexed arm muscle. Example: 力 (chikara) = power.

cards.question: 目
cards.explanation: Readings: もく (moku), め (me). Eye shape sideways. Example: 目 (me) = eye, 目標 (mokuhyou) = goal.
